gloss: to bake, to grill, to burn

definitions.gloss: to bake, to grill, to roast
definitions.explanation: To cook food using dry heat, such as in an oven or on a grill.
To damage or destroy something with fire or heat.
To create copies by burning data onto a disc.

examples.japanese: {肉|にく}を{焼|や}いて{食|た}べる。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pair: {焼|や}ける (intransitive, to burn/be grilled). Pattern: Xを{焼|や}く (bake/grill/burn X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {焼|や}いている = 'is grilling/baking.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・パンを{焼|や}く (bake bread)
・{肉|にく}を{焼|や}く (grill meat)
・{魚|さかな}を{焼|や}く (grill fish)
・CDを{焼|や}く (burn a CD)
・{日焼|ひや}けする (get sunburned—related)

CONTRAST:
・{焼|や}く (transitive): bake/burn X
・{焼|や}ける (intransitive): X burns/is grilled

FOOD-RELATED TERMS:
・{焼|や}き{鳥|とり} (grilled chicken skewers)
・{焼|や}き{魚|ざかな} (grilled fish)
・お{好|この}み{焼|や}き (Japanese savory pancake)
